diagnosis: The fleet tracking endpoint executes an InfluxQL query against the vehicle_gps measurement filtering solely by the client-provided vin. It fails to check if the vehicle belongs to the authenticated user's fleet or organization. An attacker can track the real-time and historical GPS locations and speeds of vehicles belonging to competing logistics fleets.
